quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：exploit.c 的调用改为读 PoV（只编译头文件，用 clang），按输出差分判定

category5.design: As WF_RAG_0 for XXH_swap64: a clang-built, header-only driver over the build's xxhash.h that reads the 64-bit value from the PoV and prints XXH_swap64, the 64/128-bit canonical forms and XXH3 hashes of the PoV; output-diff on exit status and output.
